# gtk4 writes a program in C, which `sngl build` compiles with the host's C
# compiler, linking GTK through the pkg-config its sngl.build names. It needs
# no display.

[!exec:pkg-config] skip 'pkg-config required'
[!exec:cc] skip 'C compiler required'
[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 development libraries required'

sngl build --platform=gtk4 --lang=c app.sngl -o out
[toolchain] exists out/app

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component counter ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.button(text="{n}", @click {
        n += 1
    })
}

ui.window(title="count") {
    counter()
}
-- testrun/build/gtk4/c/app.sngl/1 --
sha256:5a5d6bd3048e92db26c60b2f400a0fd8
